name: University of Rome Tor Vergata
scholarships: Italian public universities use a national ISEE-based (income-based) sliding-scale tuition system applicable to all students including international, via an equivalent-income declaration ('ISEE Parificato') for students whose family resides abroad; families with ISEE <=EUR 26,000 pay a minimal fixed regional/stamp fee only, with partial reductions up to ISEE ~EUR 30,000+. Per Ministerial Decree 115/2023, non-EU students from developing countries who cannot produce ISEE documentation pay a fixed EUR 500/year; other non-EU students without ISEE pay a fixed EUR 1,000/year (up to EUR 2,500 for certain English-taught courses). Separately, DSU (Diritto allo Studio Universitario) regional merit+need scholarships -- open to international students who provide equivalent foreign income documentation -- provide full fee exemption plus a cash grant and other benefits. Confirmed via University of Rome Tor Vergata's official tuition-simulator documentation; the general framework applies nationally, though this specific institution's own exact simulator figures were not individually re-run this pass.
